name: Kess
subtitle: the aurora that stays on
story: The aurora on Kess has been on since before anyone wrote things down, so the people who live there stopped looking up. Tourists lie down in the middle of the road to watch it. Commuters step around them without breaking stride. Now and then one of the commuters looks up by accident and has to sit down on the kerb for a minute.
hook: A planet for people who stopped noticing the view from their window.
beats: The aurora on Kess has never switched off, so the people who live there stopped looking up.
Now and then one of them looks up by accident and has to sit down on the kerb for a minute.
odd_line: Traffic report: three tourists lying in the high street, as usual.
rule: Tourists lying in the road must keep to the left lane.
question: What did you stop noticing where you live?
extra: The bus timetable allows three minutes per tourist.
